title: Brightline Retail security review
summary_markdown:
## Decisions
- Tom Becker, IT security lead at Brightline Retail, reviews the security questionnaire.
- Brightline needs the SOC 2 Type II report under NDA before the pilot starts.

## Next steps
- Alex Rivera sends the mutual NDA and the SOC 2 report to Tom Becker by October 2.
